user.title: Which UniFi Network?
user.description: You have more than one UniFi Network integration. Choose the one whose clients should be handed to Home Assistant's DHCP discovery. Each is shown by its name and controller address.

data_description.unifi_entry_id: The UniFi Network integration whose clients are used.

networks.title: Which networks?
networks.description: Reading from **{unifi}**. Select the networks whose clients should be handed to Home Assistant's DHCP discovery, so devices there are discovered too. Nothing is selected by default.

data_description.networks: Clients on these networks are fed to DHCP discovery. At least one is required.

abort.already_configured: This UniFi Network integration is already set up.
abort.no_unifi_entry: No loaded UniFi Network integration was found. Set it up first.
abort.no_networks: No networks could be found for this UniFi Network integration.

init.title: Networks to enrich from
init.description: Reading from **{unifi}**. Select the networks whose clients should be handed to Home Assistant's DHCP discovery.

data_description.networks: Clients on these networks are fed to DHCP discovery. At least one is required.

abort.no_unifi_entry: No loaded UniFi Network integration was found. Set it up first.

unifi_entry_missing.message: The linked UniFi Network integration no longer exists. Remove this entry or set up UniFi Network again.

unifi_not_loaded.message: The UniFi Network integration "{title}" is not loaded yet.

no_loaded_entry.message: There is no loaded UniFi DHCP enrichment entry.

unifi_unavailable.title: UniFi is unavailable
unifi_unavailable.description: The UniFi Network integration "{title}" is not reachable, so DHCP enrichment is paused. It resumes by itself when UniFi is back.

networks_missing.title: Selected UniFi networks no longer exist
networks_missing.description: These networks are selected but UniFi no longer lists them: {networks}. They are skipped. Open the integration options and update the selection.

resync.name: Resync clients
resync.description: Hand the clients of the selected UniFi networks to Home Assistant's DHCP discovery now, instead of waiting for the next automatic pass. The rate limits still apply.

force.name: Force
force.description: Hand over every client again, even if it was handed over before and DHCP discovery has seen the same data. Use it after setting up an integration, or to see in the logs how each client matches.
